Also met President Tarja Halonen and participated in wreath laying ceremony

Laid wreath at memorial to the Heroes of the Paraguayan Homeland
Visited the site of the future factory of Cement
Met with Prime Minister Donald Tusk;met with Prime Minister Mirek Topolanek
Attended final match of the Emir Cup
Passing through on his way to Finland
Also met King Juan Carlos I

Attended friendly soccer match between the Brazil and England national teams
Attended ceremony unveiling plaques alluding to countries' friendship
